Workload_Description: Git-like version control for your OneLake data files
Workload_Hub_Slogan: Bring version control to your Lakehouse data
Workload_Hub_Description:
Lakehouse File Versioning brings Git-like version control to your OneLake data files, enabling reproducible data snapshots, interactive SQL exploration, and commit-based workflows.

**Key Features:**

• Create immutable snapshots of CSV and Parquet files with commit-based versioning
• Explore and transform data using interactive SQL queries powered by DuckDB
• Navigate your data history with familiar repository and branch structures
• Ensure auditability and reproducibility for compliance and data governance
Workload_Hub_GetStarted_1_Title: Create Your First Version Controlled Lakehouse
Workload_Hub_GetStarted_1_Description: Create a new Version Controlled Lakehouse item, connect it to an existing Lakehouse, and start committing snapshots of your data files.
LakehouseGitFSItem_Description: Git-like version control for Lakehouse files with interactive SQL exploration
